import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))

# Create subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(18, 12))

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep by BMI Category
scatter = axes[0, 0].scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                             c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='viridis', 
                             s=df['Physical Activity Level']/2, alpha=0.7)
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep (1-10)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality with Stress Level', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=axes[0, 0])
cbar.set_label('Stress Level (1-10)', fontsize=10)

# 2. Average Sleep Metrics by Occupation
occupation_metrics = df.groupby('Occupation').agg({
    'Sleep Duration': 'mean',
    'Quality of Sleep': 'mean',
    'Stress Level': 'mean'
}).sort_values('Sleep Duration', ascending=False)

x = np.arange(len(occupation_metrics))
width = 0.25
axes[0, 1].bar(x - width, occupation_metrics['Sleep Duration'], width, label='Sleep Duration', color='skyblue')
axes[0, 1].bar(x, occupation_metrics['Quality of Sleep'], width, label='Quality of Sleep', color='lightgreen')
axes[0, 1].bar(x + width, occupation_metrics['Stress Level'], width, label='Stress Level', color='salmon')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Occupation', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Average Score', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Sleep Metrics by Occupation', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xticks(x)
axes[0, 1].set_xticklabels(occupation_metrics.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[0, 1].legend()

# 3. Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category
bmi_order = ['Underweight', 'Normal', 'Overweight', 'Obese']
for bmi in bmi_order:
    subset = df[df['BMI Category'] == bmi]['Sleep Duration']
    axes[0, 2].hist(subset, alpha=0.5, label=bmi, bins=15)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 2].set_title('Sleep Duration Distribution by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Correlation Heatmap
correlation_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                    'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[correlation_cols].corr()
im = axes[1, 0].imshow(corr_matrix, cmap='coolwarm', vmin=-1, vmax=1)
axes[1, 0].set_xticks(np.arange(len(correlation_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_yticks(np.arange(len(correlation_cols)))
axes[1, 0].set_xticklabels(correlation_cols, rotation=45, ha='right')
axes[1, 0].set_yticklabels(correlation_cols)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(im, ax=axes[1, 0])
cbar.set_label('Correlation Coefficient', fontsize=10)

# Add correlation values
for i in range(len(correlation_cols)):
    for j in range(len(correlation_cols)):
        text = axes[1, 0].text(j, i, f'{corr_matrix.iloc[i, j]:.2f}',
                               ha="center", va="center", color="black", fontsize=8)

# 5. Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Gender
for gender in df['Gender'].unique():
    subset = df[df['Gender'] == gender]
    axes[1, 1].scatter(subset['Physical Activity Level'], subset['Daily Steps'], 
                       alpha=0.6, label=gender, s=50)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Physical Activity vs Daily Steps by Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
axes[1, 1].legend()

# 6. Sleep Disorder Analysis
if 'Sleep Disorder' in df.columns:
    disorder_data = df[df['Sleep Disorder'].notna()]
    if not disorder_data.empty:
        disorder_counts = disorder_data['Sleep Disorder'].value_counts()
        disorder_bmi = disorder_data.groupby('Sleep Disorder')['BMI Category'].value_counts().unstack()
        disorder_bmi = disorder_bmi.reindex(columns=bmi_order, fill_value=0)
        
        disorder_bmi.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 2], colormap='Set2')
        axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Sleep Disorder', fontsize=12)
        axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=12)
        axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorders by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
        axes[1, 2].legend(title='BMI Category')
        axes[1, 2].tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
    else:
        axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'No Sleep Disorder Data', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
        axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorders by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
else:
    axes[1, 2].text(0.5, 0.5, 'Sleep Disorder column not found', ha='center', va='center', fontsize=12)
    axes[1, 2].set_title('Sleep Disorders by BMI Category', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Adjust layout
plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)
plt.tight_layout()

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
